adequacy_evidence.quote: Scientific adequacy: supported — the bounded conclusion of no whole-brain-corrected vmPFC support is supported by the one-sided whole-brain max-t FWE analysis; all reported corrected clusters are posterior, and the descriptive vmPFC interval crosses zero. The report explicitly says this is not proof of no effect or an equivalence test.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: In the 54-person NARPS equal-indifference group, the supplied gain-modulator maps do **not** support a greater response in vmPFC under whole-brain family-wise error (FWE) control.
